posts.title: Weeknotes 273: You should buy an ice cream maker
posts.description: Now that iOS 27 has been released proper, and apps have been updated, I can now order coffee again from my phone . What a relief. I followed Ricky Mondello’s guide to migrating 1Password to Apple Passwords and then had an email from 1Password saying my subscription renewal is due in a week. Decisions to be made. My personal trainer recommended that I buy an ice cream maker this week. What a week.
